headline: Axel Springer Pitched Acquisition of TikTok's European Business, FT Reports
summary: German publisher Axel Springer made an approach to acquire the European operations of short-video platform TikTok, according to the Financial Times.
why: TikTok is facing intense regulatory pressure in Western markets, and a potential carved-out acquisition in Europe would reshape digital media ownership and advertising.

impacts.name: European Media
impacts.why: A major consolidation bid for TikTok's European operations could alter market dynamics across regional online publishing.
